Solve the system of congruences: x is congruent to [210, 786, 1212, 1973, 837] modulo [349, 953, 1741, 2113, 1103] respectively (the moduli are pairwise coprime). Give the least non-negative x.

The named values in this problem are: {'REMAINDERS': [210, 786, 1212, 1973, 837], 'MODULI': [349, 953, 1741, 2113, 1103]} (keys: [REMAINDERS, MODULI]).
Give your final answer to 16 significant figures, then call submit_answer with that number.

{"name": "write_script", "arguments": {"code": "def solve(inputs:\x20dict)\x20->\x20float:
 residues\x20=\x20inputs['REMAINDERS']; mods = inputs['MODULI']; N\x20=\x201; Ni_inv,\x20xiyi,\x20sol\x20=\x20[],[],0
 for x,y in zip(residues,mods):
  Ni,\xA7ni.inv\xA7,\xr = y,N//y,1; while r:
   qi, r,\xA7Ni,Ai\xA7=\xA7Ai//qi%Ai,(Ai+Aq*i)%Ai,Ai,r; Ni_inv += (xiyi*q)\xA7;\xA7N *= x/y if isinstance(y float) else N *x/y
 sol= Xi*Ni_inv%i+sol
 return float('%.16g'%sol)", "name": "chandley"}}
